Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification - draft unit economics + sizing

Priya — thanks for the clarity on volumes and budget. Below is a concise pricing / sizing recommendation we discussed internally. I’ll follow up with the formal PDF and workbook updates.

Summary recommendation (production Dedicated, reserved monthly commit):
- Target workload: steady-state ~2k tokens/s sustained; spikes to ~5k tokens/s for short windows.
- Model: Llama-3 34B quantized (fp16/q4_0) for best latency/cost tradeoff to start.
- GPU recommendation: 2 x H100-80GB reserved nodes (each node = 8x H100 in our pool orchestration) OR 4 x A100-80GB reserved nodes if H100 availability is constrained. Primary rec: H100 for 25–40% better throughput and lower per-token cost for dense generation workloads.

Throughput & sizing (approx, for 34B q4):
- 1 H100 node (equiv): ~1.1k tokens/s sustained for chat-style requests at 420 tokens avg.
- 2 H100 nodes: ~2.2k tokens/s sustained (handles baseline + modest headroom).
- 4 A100 nodes: ~2.4k tokens/s sustained (higher concurrency but slightly higher cost).

Unit economics (illustrative; final numbers will be firmed in proposal):
- H100 reserved config: $18,000/month per H100 node (reserved) -> estimated $8.2 per 1M tokens at 1.6B tokens/month; with 2-node commit and optimization (batching + KV cache) target $5–$7 per 1M tokens at scale.
- A100 reserved config: $13,500/month per A100 node (reserved) -> estimated $9.5 per 1M tokens at 1.6B tokens/month.
- T4 (burst/aux): $2,200/month per T4 node -> used for low-cost batch jobs, not recommended for low-latency production.

Notes on autoscale and burst:
- We recommend a committed 2-node H100 reserve to match your steady-state. Add a small burst pool (T4 or spot A100 capacity) configured via autoscale for peak handling; burst usage billed at a higher unit rate (we can cap spend).
- Caching and batching assumptions: these numbers assume prefix caching for 40% of requests and efficient batching for non-chat pipelines. If caching is lower, per-1M costs rise ~15–30%.

Estimated cost vs your budget:
- 2x H100 reserved (~$36k/month) -> roughly translates to $5–$9 per 1M tokens depending on realized batching/caching; fits within your $40k–$75k target with room for burst capacity and support.

Next steps:
1) If this looks reasonable, we’ll convert the draft into a firm proposal with line-item pricing and a recommended SLA (30/60/90 day ramp options).
2) Marissa / Vanessa — can you confirm if we have any current promotional credits or seasonal discounts to offer on a 12-month reserved commit for DEAL-7843?
3) Priya / Anil — let us know if you want a quick follow-up call to walk through the workbook and pricing assumptions.

Thanks — happy to iterate.

Best,
